document.abstract: This is an updated report of the work of the Joint Technical Committee of the International Standardization Committee and the International Organization for Standardization (ISO/IEC JTC1 SC29/WG1), better known as the JPEG (Joint Photographic Experts Group) Committee. A detailed introduction to JPEG's work has already been presented. 1, 2 In this report, the focus is on the new work items since 2022. Maintenance work is also carried out but won't be described here. An overview of all JPEG work items is provided in the timetable presented in Fig. 1.
